Comparison

ElevenLabs vs Murf

A side-by-side look at ElevenLabs and Murf, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose ElevenLabs when your priority is: any application where synthetic speech has to sound genuinely human. Choose Murf when your priority is: business voiceover synced to slides or video by non-audio professionals.

ElevenLabs vs Murf at a glance

CriteriaElevenLabsMurf
CategoryAI Voice GeneratorsAI Voice Generators
Best forAny application where synthetic speech has to sound genuinely human.Business voiceover synced to slides or video by non-audio professionals.
Pricing modelFreemiumFreemium
Free planYesYes

API availableYesYes
Platforms
  • Web, iOS, Android, API, Chrome extension
  • Studio web app
  • Web (Murf Studio)
  • Chrome extension
  • Google Slides add-on
  • Canva app
  • API
Key features
  • Instant Voice Cloning (from ~1 minute of audio) and Professional Voice Cloning (from ~30 minutes, higher fidelity)
  • Eleven v3 expressive model with emotional and delivery tags
  • Dubbing Studio translating video while preserving the speaker's voice
  • Studio (long-form audiobook and podcast production)
  • Sound Effects generation
  • Conversational AI agent platform with low-latency streaming
  • 200+ voices across 20+ languages with style variants (promo, narration, conversational, angry, sad)
  • Murf Studio timeline editor syncing voice to video or slides
  • voice changer converting your recording into a professional voice
  • pronunciation and emphasis controls
  • pitch, speed and pause editing at word level
  • collaboration and commenting
Advantages
  • Output quality is the clear category benchmark - the gap to competitors is audible
  • voice cloning from one minute of audio is genuinely remarkable
  • Dubbing Studio preserving the speaker's voice across languages is a standout
  • the conversational agent platform with sub-second latency is production-grade
  • The timeline editor synced to slides and video is the real differentiator - it is a production tool rather than a TTS endpoint
  • word-level pitch, pause and emphasis control gives directorial precision that most TTS tools lack
  • the voice changer is genuinely useful for salvaging bad recordings
  • substantially cheaper than ElevenLabs at business volumes.
Limitations
  • Credits disappear extremely fast on conversational agents - a busy phone line can exhaust a Pro plan in days
  • voice cloning creates serious consent, impersonation and fraud exposure requiring governance
  • Arabic quality is good but below English
  • pricing tiers and credit allowances have been revised repeatedly and third-party sources disagree
  • Voice naturalness is clearly a step below ElevenLabs, particularly on emotional delivery
  • no voice cloning of arbitrary voices on standard tiers
  • Arabic voice quality and selection are limited
  • the annual-hours metering model is unusual and easy to misjudge

Pricing notes

ElevenLabs

Free $0 with roughly 10,000 credits/month, watermarked/attribution-required output. Starter around $5-6/mo (roughly 30,000 credits, instant voice cloning). Creator around $22/mo (roughly 100,000-121,000 credits, about 100 minutes, professional voice cloning, higher audio quality). Pro around $99/mo (roughly 600,000 credits, about 600 minutes, 44.1kHz PCM via API, 192kbps). Scale around $299-330/mo (roughly 1.8-2M credits, 3 workspace seats, 3 professional clones). Business around $990-1,320/mo (roughly 6M credits, 10 seats, 10 professional clones, low-latency TTS around 5 cents/minute). Enterprise custom. Annual billing cuts roughly 17%. Credit allowances vary slightly by source - confirm on the official page.

Murf

Free with roughly 10 minutes of voice generation and no downloads. Creator around $29/mo ($19 annually) with roughly 24 hours/year of generation, 1 seat. Growth around $99/mo ($66 annually) with roughly 96 hours/year and 3 seats. Business around $149/mo ($99 annually) with higher volume and 5 seats. Enterprise custom with unlimited generation, SSO and dedicated support. Murf API priced separately by characters.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: ElevenLabs ↗ · Murf ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between ElevenLabs and Murf?

ElevenLabs: The benchmark text-to-speech and voice cloning platform. Murf: Text-to-speech studio aimed at business voiceover production - presentations, e-learning, explainer videos and adverts.

When should I choose ElevenLabs over Murf?

ElevenLabs is listed as best for: any application where synthetic speech has to sound genuinely human. Murf is listed as best for: business voiceover synced to slides or video by non-audio professionals.

Do ElevenLabs and Murf have a free plan?

ElevenLabs: Yes. Murf: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
